title: Reverse-engineered craft flown only with the mind

tellings.quote: you you hear other stories of the >> reverse engineering program involving like the only way to fly the craft is with your mind

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says you hear stories of a secret program to copy captured non-human craft, often called reverse engineering, in which the only way to fly the craft is with your mind. If true, it would mean the craft were built for pilots who steer by thought.
